description: Six-panel composite TEM figure of the SLM Fe–30Mn–9Al–C–3Ni (P-110) low-density steel. (a) Bright-field TEM image, 200 nm scale bar, showing dense dislocation tangles in austenite; a yellow arrow labels "Dislocation" and a yellow circle marks the region used for diffraction. (b) SAED pattern, 5 1/nm scale bar, indexed as Z=[011]γ+κ: γ reflections (200), (11-1), (1-11), (-1-11), (-200), (-11-1) and κ reflections (010), (100). (c) Dark-field image, 20 nm scale bar, from a κ reflection, showing κ carbide as uniformly dispersed nanoscale bright particles, indicated by two arrows labelled "κ". (d) Bright-field TEM image, 0.5 μm scale bar, labelled "Hight-density dislocation" with a circled [011] zone. (e) HRTEM image, 2 nm scale bar, with lattice fringes measured as (200) d=0.262 nm and (1-11) d=0.223 nm, Z=[011]. (f) FFT of the HRTEM image, with indexed spots (-1-11), (1-11), (11-1), (-200), (200), (-11-1) and Z=[011], confirming the austenite zone axis. Together the panels demonstrate that the P-110 austenite matrix contains high-density dislocations and nanoscale κ carbide with a [011]γ∥[011]κ orientation relationship, with no ferrite detected.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a bright-field TEM image with a 200 nm scale bar in which a yellow arrow labelled 'Dislocation' points to dense dislocation tangles, and a yellow circle marks the diffracted zone.
Panel (b) SAED pattern carries a 5 1/nm scale bar and the annotation Z=[011]γ+κ, with γ reflections (200), (11-1), (1-11), (-1-11), (-200), (-11-1) and κ reflections (010) and (100) circled.
Panel (c) is a dark-field image with a 20 nm scale bar showing κ carbide as numerous uniformly dispersed bright nanoscale particles, marked by two arrows labelled 'κ'.
Panel (d) is a TEM image with a 0.5 μm scale bar annotated 'Hight-density dislocation' (spelling as printed) with an arrow and a yellow-circled zone.
Panel (e) HRTEM image has a 2 nm scale bar and prints two interplanar spacings: (200) d=0.262 nm and (1-11) d=0.223 nm, with Z=[011].
Panel (f) is an FFT with six indexed reflections around a central crosshair — (-1-11), (1-11), (11-1), (-200), (200), (-11-1) — labelled Z=[011].
The caption states that (f) is a fast Fourier transform (FFT) image of P-110, and that (e) is an HRTEM image.
The caption states the figure comprises (a) a TEM image, (b) SADPs of [011]γ and [011]κ, (c) a DF image of κ carbide, and (d) a TEM image of a dislocation.
The citing text reports that dislocation tangles were observed inside the austenite, attributed to thermal expansion of the constituent phases during the SLM process.
The citing text states that κ carbide is present based on the SADP acquired for zone b in Fig. 9(a), and gives the [011]γ / [011]κ orientation relationship shown in 9(b).
The citing text states that the dark-field (010) diffraction-spot image shows κ carbide composed of nanoscale particles (Fig. 9(c)).
The citing text states that the HRTEM image of 9(e) was taken from the austenite [011] zone of 9(d) and confirmed by FFT as the [011] austenite zone axis.

The citing text asserts that ferrite diffraction patterns were not detected because ferrite formation was suppressed by fast cooling during SLM; no ferrite reflections are visible in panels (b) or (f).

unreadable_items: Panel (a): the yellow-circled region is not visibly labelled with the 'b' used in the caption text ('zone b in Fig. 9(a)')
Panel (c): individual κ particles are below the resolution of the supplied rendering, so their size cannot be measured from the image
